name: Savant Sheet Metal Fabrication Shop
old_description: contractors, architects, and building owners  in New Jersey, New York & the Tri-State Area Since 2010
about:
Savant Sheet Metal Fabrication Shop was founded in 2010 by co-founders Fabrizio Bird and Ruby Lock in the Bronx, New York. The company operates a fabrication facility at 205 Frelinghuysen Avenue in Newark, New Jersey, serving contractors, architects, and building owners across the Tri-State area.

The shop specializes in custom architectural and miscellaneous metal fabrication, working with materials such as galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, copper, brass, and composite panels. Its capabilities include fiber laser cutting, CNC bending and forming, CNC shearing, welding, soldering, and tube cutting, supported by multiple CNC bending machines, a CNC shearing machine, an axis CNC machine, and a CNC aluminum saw. The team provides drafting, shop drawings, 3D rendering, project management, and design consultation, handling everything from prototype and one-off pieces to production runs for commercial projects.

Savant serves the commercial construction sector, including general contractors, roofing and glazing contractors, and architects, with projects in hospitality, healthcare, education, retail, industrial facilities, multifamily residential, and government and municipal buildings. Notable work includes replicated historical cornices, custom cove ceiling light panels, and laser-cut window shadow boxes for a Bronx housing complex.

The company emphasizes craftsmanship and attention to detail, offering emergency fabrication services, fast quotes, and quick turnaround times to meet tight project schedules.
